title: Rogues of Wall Street
description:
Reduce or prevent risk failure losses with new and emerging technologies

Rogues of Wall Street analyzes the recent risk failures and errors that have overwhelmed Wall Street for the past decade. Written by a veteran risk, compliance, and governance specialist, this book helps bank leaders and consultants identify the tools they need to effectively manage operational risk. Citing different types of risk events such as: Rogue and Insider Trading, cyber security, AML, the Mortgage Crisis, and other major events, chapters in the first half of the book detail each operational risk type along with its causative and contributing factors. The second half of the book takes an overarching approach to the tools and solutions available to financial institutions to manage such events in the future. From technology, to culture, to governance, and more, this book does more than simply identify the problem—it provides real-world solutions with actionable insight.

Expert discussion identifies the tools financial institutions have at their disposal, and how these tools can be leveraged to create an environment in which catastrophic events are prevented or mitigated. In-depth insight from an industry specialist provides thought-provoking guidance for leaders seeking more effective risk management, and specifically addresses how to:

Analyze major operational risk incidents and their underlying causes
Investigate the tools that allow organizations to prevent and mitigate catastrophic events
Learn how culture and governance can be optimized to support effective risk management
Identify ways in which cognitive technologies could help your firm avoid losses

Cognitive technologies have the potential to revolutionize the way business is done; eliminating the speed/cost/quality trade-off, these new and emerging tools are heralding the next leap in the evolution of risk management. Rogues of Wall Street shows you how bring these tools into your organization, and how they can contribute to your financial success.
translatedDescription:
Reducir o prevenir pérdidas por fallo de riesgo con tecnologías nuevas y emergentes

Rogues of Wall Street analiza los recientes fallos de riesgo y errores que han abrumado a Wall Street durante la última década. Escrito por un veterano especialista en riesgo, cumplimiento y gobernanza, este libro ayuda a los líderes bancarios y consultores a identificar las herramientas que necesitan para gestionar eficazmente el riesgo operacional. Citando diferentes tipos de eventos de riesgo como: Rogue y Insider Trading, seguridad cibernética, AML, la crisis de hipotecas y otros eventos importantes, capítulos en la primera mitad del libro detallan cada tipo de riesgo operacional junto con sus factores causantes y contribuyentes. La segunda mitad del libro adopta un enfoque global de las herramientas y soluciones disponibles para las instituciones financieras para gestionar tales eventos en el futuro. De la tecnología, a la cultura, a la gobernanza, y más, este libro hace más que simplemente identificar el problema: proporciona soluciones reales con una visión práctica.

El debate de expertos identifica los instrumentos que las instituciones financieras tienen a su disposición, y cómo se pueden aprovechar estos instrumentos para crear un entorno en el que se impidan o mitiguen los acontecimientos catastróficos. Una visión profunda de un especialista en la industria proporciona orientación que promueve el pensamiento para los líderes que buscan una gestión más eficaz del riesgo, y aborda específicamente cómo:

Analizar los principales incidentes de riesgo operacional y sus causas subyacentes
Investigar las herramientas que permiten a las organizaciones prevenir y mitigar eventos catastróficos
Aprenda cómo se puede optimizar la cultura y la gobernanza para apoyar una gestión eficaz del riesgo
Identificar formas en que las tecnologías cognitivas pueden ayudar a su empresa a evitar pérdidas

Las tecnologías cognitivas tienen el potencial de revolucionar la forma en que se hace el negocio; eliminando la velocidad/cost/calidad, estas nuevas y emergentes herramientas están anunciando el próximo salto en la evolución de la gestión del riesgo. Rogues of Wall Street le muestra cómo traer estas herramientas a su organización, y cómo pueden contribuir a su éxito financiero.

title: Equity Hybrid Derivatives
description:
Take an in-depth look at equity hybrid derivatives.

Written by the quantitative research team of Deutsche Bank, the world leader in innovative equity derivative transactions, this book presents leading-edge thinking in modeling, valuing, and hedging for this market, which is increasingly used for investment by hedge funds. You'll gain a balanced, integrated presentation of theory and practice, with an emphasis on understanding new techniques for analyzing volatility and credit derivative transactions linked to equity. In every instance, theory is illustrated along with practical application.

Marcus Overhaus, PhD, is Managing Director and Global Head of Quantitative Research and Equity Structuring. Ana Bermudez, PhD, is an Associate in Global Quantitative Research. Hans Buehler, PhD, is a Vice President in Global Quantitative Research. Andrew Ferraris, DPhil, is a Managing Director in Global Quantitative Research. Christopher Jordinson, PhD, is a Vice President in Global Quantitative Research. Aziz Lamnouar, DEA, is a Vice President in Global Quantitative Research. All are associated with Deutsche Bank AG, London.

Ganarás una presentación equilibrada e integrada de la teoría y la práctica, con énfasis en la comprensión de nuevas técnicas para analizar la volatilidad y las transacciones derivadas de crédito vinculadas a la equidad. En cada caso, la teoría se ilustra junto con la aplicación práctica.

title: Panic, Prosperity, and Progress: Five Centuries of History and the Markets
description:
A detailed guide to financial market performance during financial crises

With the financial markets seemingly careening from one crisis to another, it's vital for today's investors and traders to have an historical perspective on market performance during times of great turmoil. In this book, Tim Knight provides an exhaustive analysis of financial market behavior prior, during, and following tumultuous events since 1600.

Making copious use of charts and basic technical analysis, Knight demonstrates how external shocks tend to create extreme reactions in the financial markets and how these predictable reactions provide opportunities for investors and traders to profit. Knight traverses five centuries of financial market history, from Tulipmania in the 1600s to the contemporary sovereign debt crisis. He looks at each event from the prism of the financial markets, examining the market climate prior to the event, during the event, and following the event.

Draws essential lessons from history providing investors and traders with guidelines to better navigate markets in today's tumultuous times

Offers valuable insights on understanding and anticipating market responses to shocks and crises

Companion website with a Q&A section contains charts from key moments in past financial crises and asks readers to choose whether to go long, short, or step aside

If you're looking for a better way to make it today's dynamic markets, look no further than this timely book.

Utilizando copiosos gráficos y análisis técnicos básicos, Knight demuestra cómo las conmociones externas tienden a crear reacciones extremas en los mercados financieros y cómo estas reacciones predecibles proporcionan oportunidades a los inversores y a los comerciantes para obtener ganancias. description:
This Element is an excerpt from Technical Analysis Plain and Simple: Charting the Markets in Your Language (9780137042012), by Michael N. Kahn, CMT. Available in print and digital formats.

How to “let the market talk” and bring flexibility to technical analysis, instead of squeezing complex, organic markets into artificial textbook definitions.

Market analysis is just not a precise endeavor. The market is a living being: It does not react to the world exactly the same way twice. Flexibility is key: If you stick too closely to textbook definitions, you may be right, but you’ll have a lot of losing trades.

In The Volatility Edge in Options Trading, leading options trader Jeff Augen introduces breakthrough strategies for identifying subtle price distortions that arise from changes in market volatility. What’s more, Augen shows how to build your own customized analytical toolset using low-cost desktop software and data sources: tools that can transform his state-of-the-art strategies into practical buy/sell guidance.

Building a state-of-the-art analytical infrastructure

Use standard desktop software and data sources to build world-class decision-making tools

title: Trading VIX Derivatives: Trading and Hedging Strategies Using VIX Futures, Options, and Exchange-Traded Notes
description:
A guide to using the VIX to forecast and trade markets

Known as the fear index, the VIX provides a snapshot of expectations about future stock market volatility and generally moves inversely to the overall stock market. Trading VIX Derivatives will show you how to use the Chicago Board Options Exchange's S&P 500 volatility index to gauge fear and greed in the market, use market volatility to your advantage, and hedge stock portfolios. Engaging and informative, this book skillfully explains the mechanics and strategies associated with trading VIX options, futures, exchange traded notes, and options on exchange traded notes.

Many market participants look at the VIX to help understand market sentiment and predict turning points. With a slew of VIX index trading products now available, traders can use a variety of strategies to speculate outright on the direction of market volatility, but they can also utilize these products in conjunction with other instruments to create spread trades or hedge their overall risk.

Reviews how to use the VIX to forecast market turning points, as well as reveals what it takes to implement trading strategies using VIX options, futures, and ETNs

Accessible to active individual traders, but sufficiently sophisticated for professional traders

Offers insights on how volatility-based strategies can be used to provide diversification and enhance returns

Written by Russell Rhoads, a top instructor at the CBOE's Options Institute, this book reflects on the wide range of uses associated with the VIX and will interest anyone looking for profitable new forecasting and trading techniques.

title: Derivatives Demystified: A Step-by-Step Guide to Forwards, Futures, Swaps and Options, Second Edition
description:
Derivatives are everywhere in the modern world and it is important for everyone in banking, investment and finance to have a good understanding of the subject. Derivatives Demystified provides a step-by-step guide to the subject, enabling the reader to have a solid, working understanding of key derivative products.

Adopting a highly accessible approach, the author explains derivative products in straightforward terms and without the complex mathematics that underlie the subject, focusing on practical applications, case studies and examples of how the products are used to solve real-world problems. Derivatives Demystified follows a sequence that is designed to show that, although there are many applications of derivatives, there are only a small number of basic building blocks, namely forwards and futures, swaps and options. The book shows how each building block is applied to different markets and to the solution of various risk management and trading problems.

This new edition will be fully revised to reflect the many changes the derivatives markets have seen over the last three years. New material will include a comprehensive history of derivatives, leading up to their use and abuse in the current credit crisis. It will also feature new chapters on regulation and control of derivatives, commodity derivatives, credit derivatives and structured products and new derivative markets including inflation linked and insurance linked products.

Derivatives Demystified is essential reading for everyone who operates in the financial markets or within the corporate environment who requires a good understanding of these important financial instruments.

title: The Little Book of Stock Market Cycles: How to Take Advantage of Time-Proven Market Patterns

While cycles do not repeat exactly all of the time, statistical evidence suggests that cyclical tendencies are very strong and should not be ignored by investors. The Little Book of Stock Market Cycles will show you how to profit from these recurring stock market patterns and cycles.

Written by Jeffrey Hirsch, President of the Hirsch Organization and Editor-in-Chief of the Stock Trader's Almanac, this reliable resource explains why these cycles occur, provides the historical evidence behind them, and shows you how to capture consistent profits from them moving forward. In addition to describing his most widely followed cycles and patters, Hirsch also discusses both longer term boom-bust economic cycles and shorter term tendencies involving the best days, weeks, and months of the year to trade the market.

The methods found here follow everything from presidential election cycles to the "Santa Claus" effect

Written by Jeffrey Hirsch, the pre-eminent authority on market cycles and seasonal patterns

The strategies explored are easy-to-implement, and based on research that has proven profitable over the course of time

For investors looking to beat the buy-and-hold philosophy, The Little Book of Stock Market Cycles will provide simple, actionable ideas that have stood the test of time and consistently outperformed the market.
translatedDescription:
Jeffrey Hirsch discute cómo capturar las rentabilidades de consumo de mercado siguiendo ciclos específicos del mercado de valores

Mientras que predecir la dirección del mercado de valores en cualquier momento es difícil, es un hecho que el mercado exhibe patrones bien definidos y a veces predecibles. Aunque los ciclos no repiten exactamente todo el tiempo, las pruebas estadísticas sugieren que las tendencias cíclicas son muy fuertes y no deben ser ignoradas por los inversores. El Pequeño Libro de Ciclos del Mercado de Valores le mostrará cómo aprovechar estos patrones y ciclos recurrentes del mercado de valores.

Escrito por Jeffrey Hirsch, presidente de la Organización Hirsch y editor en jefe del Almanac del comerciante de acciones, este recurso confiable explica por qué estos ciclos ocurren, proporciona la evidencia histórica detrás de ellos, y le muestra cómo capturar ganancias consistentes de ellos avanzando. Además de describir sus ciclos y patters más seguidos, Hirsch también habla de ciclos económicos a largo plazo y tendencias a corto plazo que implican los mejores días, semanas y meses del año para el comercio del mercado.

Los métodos encontrados aquí siguen todo desde los ciclos electorales presidenciales hasta el efecto "Santa Claus"

Escrito por Jeffrey Hirsch, la autoridad preeminente en ciclos de mercado y patrones estacionales

Las estrategias exploradas son fáciles de aplicar y basadas en investigaciones que han resultado rentables durante el tiempo

Para los inversores que buscan superar la filosofía de compra y retención, The Little Book of Stock Market Cycles proporcionará ideas simples y factibles que han soportado la prueba del tiempo y han superado constantemente el mercado.

title: Fundamentals of Finance
description:
Finance is the study of how individuals, institutions, governments, and businesses acquire, spend, and manage their money and other financial assets to maximize their value or wealth. Fundamentals of Finance introduces the nuances of finance in a comprehensive yet concise manner and is essential reading for professionals building a career in finance or for students taking a course in finance. The book consists of four parts:

Part I: "Introduction to Finance, Money and Interest Rates, and Time Value of Money" focuses on the role financial markets play in the financial system and financial basics that underlie how markets operate.

Part II: "Investments and Portfolio Management" discusses the characteristics of stocks and bonds, how securities are valued, the operations of securities markets, formation of optimal portfolios, and derivatives.

Part III: "Financial Management/Corporate Finance" explores financial planning, asset management, and fund-raising activities that will enhance a firm’s value.

Part IV: "Management of Financial Institutions" focuses on management of financial institutions in general, and risk management in financial institutions in particular.

The book’s many examples, appendices, graphs and tables provide valuable know-how to a wide audience, making it an excellent resource for professionals as well as students who wish to attain a broad understanding of finance.

Please contact Stefan.Giesen@degruyter.com to request additional instructional material comprising a chapter-wise listing of questions and answers.
translatedDescription:
La financiación es el estudio de cómo las personas, instituciones, gobiernos y empresas adquieren, gastan y administran su dinero y otros activos financieros para maximizar su valor o riqueza. Fundamentos de Finanzas introduce los matices de la financiación de manera integral pero concisa y es lectura esencial para los profesionales que construyen una carrera en finanzas o para los estudiantes que toman un curso en finanzas. El libro consta de cuatro partes:

Parte I: "Introducción a las tasas de finanzas, dinero e intereses y el valor del tiempo del dinero" se centra en el papel que juegan los mercados financieros en el sistema financiero y los fundamentos financieros que subyacen a la forma en que operan los mercados.

Parte II: "Inversiones y gestión de carteras" analiza las características de las acciones y bonos, cómo se valoran los valores, las operaciones de los mercados de valores, la formación de carteras óptimas y derivados.

Parte III: "Manejo Financiero/Finanza Corporativa" explora la planificación financiera, la gestión de activos y actividades de recaudación de fondos que mejorarán el valor de una firma.

Parte IV: "Management of Financial Institutions" se centra en la gestión de las instituciones financieras en general, y la gestión de riesgos en las instituciones financieras en particular.

Los numerosos ejemplos, apéndices, gráficos y tablas del libro proporcionan valiosos conocimientos a un amplio público, lo que lo convierte en un excelente recurso para los profesionales y estudiantes que desean alcanzar una amplia comprensión de las finanzas.

Contacta con Stefan. Giesen@degruyter.com para solicitar material didáctico adicional que incluya una lista de preguntas y respuestas por capítulo.

What this Book will help me do

Set up a Fedora workstation and manage key system configurations from scratch.
Optimize workstation performance through effective tuning of Linux resources.
Secure your system using Fedora-specific solutions such as SELinux.

This book is written for system administrators, software developers, and enthusiasts who wish to deepen their knowledge of Fedora Linux. Whether you're a beginner with basic Linux familiarity or an advanced user seeking optimization techniques, you'll find practical guidance inside to meet your goals.

title: The Money Formula
description:
Explore the deadly elegance of finance's hidden powerhouse

The Money Formula takes you inside the engine room of the global economy to explore the little-understood world of quantitative finance, and show how the future of our economy rests on the backs of this all-but-impenetrable industry. Written not from a post-crisis perspective – but from a preventative point of view – this book traces the development of financial derivatives from bonds to credit default swaps, and shows how mathematical formulas went beyond pricing to expand their use to the point where they dwarfed the real economy. You'll learn how the deadly allure of their ice-cold beauty has misled generations of economists and investors, and how continued reliance on these formulas can either assist future economic development, or send the global economy into the financial equivalent of a cardiac arrest.

Rather than rehash tales of post-crisis fallout, this book focuses on preventing the next one. By exploring the heart of the shadow economy, you'll be better prepared to ride the rough waves of finance into the turbulent future.

Delve into one of the world's least-understood but highest-impact industries
Understand the key principles of quantitative finance and the evolution of the field
Learn what quantitative finance has become, and how it affects us all
Discover how the industry's next steps dictate the economy's future

How do you create a quadrillion dollars out of nothing, blow it away and leave a hole so large that even years of "quantitative easing" can't fill it – and then go back to doing the same thing? Even amidst global recovery, the financial system still has the potential to seize up at any moment. The Money Formula explores the how and why of financial disaster, what must happen to prevent the next one.
translatedDescription:
Explore la elegancia mortal de la central eléctrica oculta de finanzas

La Fórmula de Dinero te lleva dentro de la sala de motores de la economía global para explorar el mundo poco entendido de la financiación cuantitativa, y mostrar cómo el futuro de nuestra economía descansa en la parte posterior de esta industria todo-pero-impenetrable. Escrito no desde una perspectiva post-crisis – pero desde un punto de vista preventivo – este libro rastrea el desarrollo de derivados financieros de bonos a cambios por defecto de crédito, y muestra cómo las fórmulas matemáticas iban más allá de los precios para expandir su uso al punto en que enanaron la economía real. Aprenderás cómo el mortífero alboroto de su belleza helada ha engañado a generaciones de economistas e inversores, y cómo la dependencia continua de estas fórmulas puede ayudar al desarrollo económico futuro, o enviar la economía global al equivalente financiero de un paro cardíaco.

En lugar de rehash cuentos de caída post-crisis, este libro se centra en prevenir el siguiente. Al explorar el corazón de la economía sombría, estarás mejor preparado para llevar las olas de la financiación al futuro turbulento.

Entrar en una de las industrias menos comprendidas del mundo pero de mayor impacto
Comprender los principios fundamentales de la financiación cuantitativa y la evolución del campo
Aprenda qué finanzas cuantitativas se ha convertido, y cómo nos afecta a todos
Descubra cómo los próximos pasos de la industria dictan el futuro de la economía

¿Cómo creas un cuadrillón de dólares de la nada, lo arruinas y dejas un hoyo tan grande que ni siquiera años de "asasamiento cuantitativo" pueden llenarlo – y luego volver a hacer lo mismo? Incluso en medio de la recuperación mundial, el sistema financiero todavía tiene el potencial de aprovecharse en cualquier momento. La Fórmula del Dinero explora el cómo y por qué del desastre financiero, lo que debe suceder para prevenir el próximo.

title: The Million-Dollar Financial Advisor
description: The best financial advisors are well equipped to succeed regardless of market conditions. The second is an account of a remarkable and inspiring career turn around and demonstrates that it’s never too late to reinvent oneself. title: Get Started in Shares
description:
Investing can be fun as well as rewarding.  It could certainly earn you much more than you could gain by sticking your money in a bank account. It really does not require much to make money from the stock market - just an understanding of a few simple concepts and the following of a few rules.

title: A Demon of Our Own Design: Markets, Hedge Funds, and the Perils of Financial Innovation
description:
Inside markets, innovation, and risk

Why do markets keep crashing and why are financial crises greater than ever before? As the risk manager to some of the leading firms on Wall Street-from Morgan Stanley to Salomon and Citigroup-and a member of some of the world's largest hedge funds, from Moore Capital to Ziff Brothers and FrontPoint Partners, Rick Bookstaber has seen the ghost inside the machine and vividly shows us a world that is even riskier than we think. The very things done to make markets safer, have, in fact, created a world that is far more dangerous. From the 1987 crash to Citigroup closing the Salomon Arb unit, from staggering losses at UBS to the demise of Long-Term Capital Management, Bookstaber gives readers a front row seat to the management decisions made by some of the most powerful financial figures in the world that led to catastrophe, and describes the impact of his own activities on markets and market crashes. Much of the innovation of the last 30 years has wreaked havoc on the markets and cost trillions of dollars. A Demon of Our Own Design tells the story of man's attempt to manage market risk and what it has wrought. In the process of showing what we have done, Bookstaber shines a light on what the future holds for a world where capital and power have moved from Wall Street institutions to elite and highly leveraged hedge funds.
translatedDescription:
Dentro de mercados, innovación y riesgo

¿Por qué los mercados siguen chocando y por qué son crisis financieras mayores que nunca antes? Como gerente de riesgo para algunas de las principales firmas de Wall Street-de Morgan Stanley a Salomon y Citigroup-y miembro de algunos de los fondos de cobertura más grandes del mundo, de Moore Capital a Ziff Brothers y FrontPoint Partners, Rick Bookstaber ha visto el fantasma dentro de la máquina y nos muestra vívidamente un mundo que es aún más arriesgado de lo que pensamos. Las mismas cosas que se hacen para hacer los mercados más seguros, han creado, de hecho, un mundo mucho más peligroso. Desde el accidente de 1987 a Citigroup cerrando la unidad Salomon Arb, desde pérdidas asombrosas en UBS hasta la desaparición de Long-Term Capital Management, Bookstaber da a los lectores un asiento de primera fila a las decisiones de gestión tomadas por algunas de las figuras financieras más poderosas del mundo que llevaron a la catástrofe, y describe el impacto de sus propias actividades en los mercados y los fallos del mercado. Gran parte de la innovación de los últimos 30 años ha causado estragos en los mercados y ha costado billones de dólares. Un Demonio de Nuestro propio Diseño cuenta la historia del intento del hombre de gestionar el riesgo de mercado y lo que ha hecho. En el proceso de mostrar lo que hemos hecho, Bookstaber brilla una luz sobre lo que el futuro tiene para un mundo donde el capital y el poder se han trasladado de instituciones de Wall Street a fondos de cobertura altamente apalancados.

title: Chart Your Way to Profits: The Online Trader's Guide to Technical Analysis with ProphetCharts, Second Edition
description:
A cutting-edge guide to turning technical analysis into trading success,

Chart Your Way to Profits, Second Edition shows you how to use the powerful technology available online in conjunction with technical analysis to assess markets and make the most profitable trading decisions possible.

In the book, author Tim Knight discusses the key aspects of technical analysis and reveals how to design your own charts and indicators in a way that enables you to easily monitor the markets and make solid trading decisions. This new edition discusses a wider range of technical tools within ProphetCharts and shows you how to evaluate and compare industry sectors and groups of stocks to identify the best trading opportunities.

Features many new technical tools for tracking individual stocks

Illustrates how to use the highly-rated online application ProphetCharts to create state-of-art, customized graphs

Helps hone your own analysis skills through hundreds of real-world examples

Written in a straightforward and accessible manner, Chart Your Way to Profits, Second Edition not only explains technical analysis, but also provides readers with examples demonstrating how effective technical analysis can identify highly profitable trades.

En el libro, el autor Tim Knight discute los aspectos clave del análisis técnico y revela cómo diseñar sus propios gráficos e indicadores de una manera que le permita controlar fácilmente los mercados y tomar decisiones comerciales sólidas. title: Introduction to Option-Adjusted Spread Analysis: Revised and Expanded Third Edition of the OAS Classic by Tom Windas
description:
Top traders, investors, and analysts agree that one method, option-adjusted spread (OAS) analysis, is the most useful way to compare and value securities with options. Nearly every day the bond market figures out a new way to structure securities, most of which involve options.

This book explains OAS analysis in plain English, presenting each step in the method clearly and concisely. Topics covered include:

Why yield-based analysis breaks down for nonbullet bonds

How to model put and call provisions as embedded options

How to distinguish the intrinsic and time components of option value

How to model interest-rate volatility, future interest rates, and future bond prices

How to calculate option-free price and yield

How to estimate the "fair value" of a bond

How to calculate implied spot and forward rates

Salespeople, traders, and investors will want to read this book and keep it on their desks.
translatedDescription:
Los mejores traders, inversores y analistas están de acuerdo en que un método, análisis de propagación ajustada por opciones (OAS), es la forma más útil de comparar y valorar valores con opciones. Casi todos los días el mercado de bonos muestra una nueva manera de estructurar valores, la mayoría de los cuales implican opciones.

Este libro explica el análisis de la OEA en inglés claro, presentando cada paso en el método de manera clara y concisa. Los temas tratados incluyen:

¿Por qué el análisis basado en el rendimiento se descompone para los bonos de nobulto

Cómo modelar las disposiciones y llamarlas como opciones incrustadas

Cómo distinguir los componentes intrínsecos y temporales del valor de opción

Cómo modelar la volatilidad de los tipos de interés futuros y los futuros precios de los bonos

Cómo calcular el precio y rendimiento sin opción

Cómo estimar el "valor razonable" de un bono

Cómo calcular puntos implícitos y tasas de avance

Los vendedores, comerciantes e inversores querrán leer este libro y mantenerlo en sus escritorios.

title: Trading Realities: The Truth, the Lies, and the Hype In-Between
description: Trading Realities teaches investors and traders the universal, basic principles that apply to every financial market: stocks, bonds, commodities, foreign exchange, futures, options, and beyond. Writing for beginners and experienced investors alike, successful trader and author Jeff Augen illuminates key issues that are often mentioned but rarely fully understood: issues such as leverage, liquidity, market trends, risk, valuation, interest rates, and the impact of news and events. Most important, he shows how to apply this knowledge to trade and invest far more profitably. Augen focuses on the massive forces that really move financial markets: the market dynamics that are fundamental to your success, regardless of your investment strategies or the asset classes you choose. You'll learn how to value markets in absolute terms (e.g. constant currency), rank investment vehicles according to risk; assess the real impact of leverage and the true meaning of trends; interpret the flow of money between markets; and much more. Augen shows how to identify and collect the information that matters most (and ignore the information that doesn't matter). Once you have the facts you need, you'll learn how to use those facts to gain a clear advantage: one that you can sustain through any market environment.
translatedDescription: Trading Realities enseña a inversores y comerciantes los principios universales y básicos que se aplican a cada mercado financiero: acciones, bonos, mercancías, divisas, futuros, opciones y más allá. Escribir para principiantes e inversores experimentados por igual, exitoso comerciante y autor Jeff Augen ilumina cuestiones clave que a menudo se mencionan pero raramente se entienden plenamente: temas como el apalancamiento, liquidez, tendencias de mercado, riesgo, valoración, tipos de interés, y el impacto de noticias y eventos. Lo más importante, muestra cómo aplicar este conocimiento al comercio e invertir mucho más provechoso. Augen se centra en las fuerzas masivas que realmente mueven los mercados financieros: la dinámica del mercado que son fundamentales para su éxito, independientemente de sus estrategias de inversión o las clases de activos que elija. Aprenderás a valorar los mercados en términos absolutos (por ejemplo, moneda constante), clasificar los vehículos de inversión según el riesgo; evaluar el impacto real del apalancamiento y el verdadero significado de las tendencias; interpretar el flujo del dinero entre mercados; y mucho más. Augen muestra cómo identificar y recoger la información que más importa (y ignorar la información que no importa). Una vez que usted tenga los hechos que necesita, usted aprenderá a utilizar esos hechos para obtener una ventaja clara: uno que usted puede sostener a través de cualquier entorno de mercado.

title: Risk: The New Management Imperative in Finance
description:
Finance professionals grapple with risk every day—it's the inescapable partner of all financial market participants. As a result, high-stakes financial professionals are continually trying to streamline and perfect their risk management techniques. Financial risk management quantifies and controls risk (loss potential) and helps drive capital to its optimal use (profit seeking). This book is a much-needed guide for financial firms. It describes the latest risk management tools, financial instruments, and practical implementation strategies. And they're presented in a real-world, nonacademic manner. This book presents the latest information on

Identifying risk: the spectrum of risks faced by market participants

Measuring and quantifying risk: ways to track and value market and credit risks

Managing risk: a practical framework for financial risk management implementation

Also includes "The Ten Commandments of Financial Risk Management," how and when to use the latest financial instruments and derivatives, and setting up a trackable risk management initiative.

La gestión del riesgo financiero cuantifica y controla el riesgo (perder potencial) y ayuda a impulsar el capital a su uso óptimo (buscar ganancias). Este libro es una guía muy necesaria para las empresas financieras. En él se describen los últimos instrumentos de gestión del riesgo, instrumentos financieros y estrategias prácticas de aplicación. Y se presentan en un mundo real, de manera no académica. Este libro presenta la información más reciente

Determinación del riesgo: el espectro de riesgos que enfrentan los participantes en el mercado

Medición y cuantificación del riesgo: formas de rastrear y valorar los riesgos del mercado y del crédito

También incluye "Los Diez Mandamientos de Gestión de Riesgos Financieros", cómo y cuándo utilizar los últimos instrumentos financieros y derivados, y establecer una iniciativa de gestión de riesgos rastreable.

title: Portfolio Management in Practice
description: As individuals are becoming more and more responsible for ensuring their own financial future, portfolio or fund management has taken on an increasingly important role in banks' ranges of offerings to their clients. In addition, as interest rates have come down and the stock market has gone up and come down again, clients have a choice of leaving their saving in deposit accounts, or putting those savings in unit trusts or investment portfolios which invest in equities and/or bonds. Individuals are becoming aware that they might need to top up government pension allocations. Likewise, corporations who run employee pension schemes have to ensure that they are able to cover their current and future liabilities. Investing in unit trusts or mutual funds is one way for individuals and corporations alike to potentially enhance the returns on their savings.Introduction to Portfolio Management covers the:*Theoretical underpinnings of portfolio management*Basics of portfolio construction*Constraints to be considered when building a client portfolio*Types of analysis used for asset allocation and stock selection*Main types of funds available to investors*Inspired from the basic entry level training courses that have been developed by major international banks worldwide.*Will enable MSc Finance students, MBA students and those already in the finance profession to gain an understanding of the basic information and principles underlying the topic under discussion*Questions with answers, study topics, practical "real world" examples and text with an extensive bibliography and references ensure learning outcomes can be immediately applied
translatedDescription: A medida que las personas se están haciendo cada vez más responsables de garantizar su propio futuro financiero, la gestión de carteras o fondos ha asumido un papel cada vez más importante en las ofertas de los bancos a sus clientes. Además, como las tasas de interés han bajado y el mercado de valores ha subido y bajado de nuevo, los clientes tienen la opción de dejar su ahorro en cuentas de depósito, o poner esos ahorros en fideicomisos unitarios o carteras de inversiones que invierten en acciones y/o bonos. Las personas están advirtiendo que tal vez necesiten superar las asignaciones de pensiones gubernamentales. Asimismo, las empresas que ejecutan planes de pensiones de los empleados tienen que asegurarse de que puedan cubrir sus obligaciones actuales y futuras. Invertir en fideicomisos o fondos mutuos es una manera para que las personas y las empresas puedan mejorar los rendimientos de sus ahorros. Introducción a Portfolio Management cubre los siguientes ejes:*Apoyos teóricos de gestión de cartera*Basics of portfolio construction*Constraints to be considered when building a client portfolio*Types of analysis used for asset allocation and stock selection*Main types of funds available to investors* Inspirados en los cursos básicos de capacitación de nivel de entrada que han sido elaborados por los principales bancos internacionales en todo el mundo. * Permitirá que estudiantes de MSc Finance, estudiantes de MBA y aquellos que ya están en la profesión financiera obtengan una comprensión de la información básica y los principios subyacentes al tema en discusión*Preguntas con respuestas, temas de estudio, ejemplos prácticos de "mundo real" y texto con una extensa bibliografía y referencias aseguran que los resultados de aprendizaje se puedan aplicar inmediatamente

title: The Art of Deception: Controlling the Human Element of Security
description:
The world's most infamous hacker offers an insider's view of the low-tech threats to high-tech security

Kevin Mitnick's exploits as a cyber-desperado and fugitive form one of the most exhaustive FBI manhunts in history and have spawned dozens of articles, books, films, and documentaries. Since his release from federal prison, in 1998, Mitnick has turned his life around and established himself as one of the most sought-after computer security experts worldwide. Now, in The Art of Deception, the world's most notorious hacker gives new meaning to the old adage, "It takes a thief to catch a thief."

Focusing on the human factors involved with information security, Mitnick explains why all the firewalls and encryption protocols in the world will never be enough to stop a savvy grifter intent on rifling a corporate database or an irate employee determined to crash a system. With the help of many fascinating true stories of successful attacks on business and government, he illustrates just how susceptible even the most locked-down information systems are to a slick con artist impersonating an IRS agent. Narrating from the points of view of both the attacker and the victims, he explains why each attack was so successful and how it could have been prevented in an engaging and highly readable style reminiscent of a true-crime novel. And, perhaps most importantly, Mitnick offers advice for preventing these types of social engineering hacks through security protocols, training programs, and manuals that address the human element of security.
translatedDescription:
El hacker más famoso del mundo ofrece una visión interior de las amenazas de baja tecnología a la seguridad de alta tecnología

Las hazañas de Kevin Mitnick como una forma ciberdesesperada y fugitiva uno de los más exhaustivos de la historia del FBI y han generado decenas de artículos, libros, películas y documentales. Desde su liberación de la prisión federal, en 1998, Mitnick ha convertido su vida y se ha establecido como uno de los expertos en seguridad informática más buscados en todo el mundo. Ahora, en El Arte de la Decepción, el hacker más notorio del mundo da nuevo significado al viejo adage, "Se necesita un ladrón para atrapar a un ladrón".

Centrándose en los factores humanos involucrados en la seguridad de la información, Mitnick explica por qué todos los cortafuegos y protocolos de cifrado en el mundo nunca serán suficientes para detener una inteligente intención de enjuagar una base de datos corporativa o un empleado irate decidido a estrellar un sistema. Con la ayuda de muchas historias fascinantes de ataques exitosos contra el negocio y el gobierno, ilustra lo susceptibles que son incluso los sistemas de información más cerrados a un artista consiguiente que imita a un agente del IRS. Partiendo de los puntos de vista tanto del atacante como de las víctimas, explica por qué cada ataque tuvo tanto éxito y cómo se pudo evitar en un estilo atractivo y muy legible que recuerda a una novela de verdadero crimen. Y, quizás lo más importante, Mitnick ofrece consejos para prevenir estos tipos de hacks de ingeniería social a través de protocolos de seguridad, programas de capacitación y manuales que abordan el elemento humano de la seguridad.

title: Mergers, Acquisitions, and Corporate Restructurings, Fourth Edition
authors: NY Patrick A. Gaughan New York
description: Modern restructuring techniques for a global business landscape Corporate restructurings are an indispensable tool in building a new generation of re-engineered companies with the power and resources to compete on a global playing field. Written from a practical and historical perspective, Mergers, Acquisitions, and Corporate Restructurings, Fourth Edition carefully analyzes the strategies and motives that inspire M&As, the laws and rules that govern the field, as well as the offensive and defensive techniques of hostile acquisitions. In this thoroughly revised Fourth Edition, author and business valuation expert Patrick Gaughan provides a fresh perspective on M&As in today's global business landscape, and how your company can reap the benefits from the various forms of restructurings available. Packed with the most up-to-date research, graphs, and case studies, Mergers, Acquisitions, and Corporate Restructurings, Fourth Edition explores: * Recent takeover trends including the role of private equity firms and hedge funds * Most effective offensive and defensive tactics in hostile bids * A review of the effect of shareholder wealth on a variety of takeover actions * Modern, historical, and global perspectives on the field * The various forms of downsizing including divestitures, spinoffs, and equity carve-outs * Bankruptcy as an effective restructuring technique * Latest developments in corporate governance * Pros and cons of joint ventures and strategic alliances * Primary methods used to value public and private companies

Escrito desde una perspectiva práctica e histórica, Mergers, Adquisición y Reestructuraciones Corporativas, Cuarta Edición analiza cuidadosamente las estrategias y los motivos que inspiren a M plagaAs, las leyes y reglas que rigen el campo, así como las técnicas ofensivas y defensivas de adquisiciones hostiles. title: Socially Responsible Finance and Investing: Financial Institutions, Corporations, Investors, and Activists
description:
A detailed look at the role of social responsibility in finance and investing

The concept of socially responsible finance and investing continues to grow, especially in the wake of one of the most devastating financial crises in history. This includes responsibility from the corporate side (corporate social responsibility) as well as the investor side (socially responsible investing) of the capital markets. Filled with in-depth insights and practical advice, Socially Responsible Finance and Investing offers an important basis of knowledge regarding both the theory and practice of this ever-evolving area of finance.

As part of the Robert W. Kolb Series in Finance, this book showcases contributed chapters from professionals and academics with extensive expertise on this particular subject. It provides a comprehensive view of socially responsible foundations and their applications to finance and investing as determined by the current state of research.

Discusses many important issues associated with socially responsible finance and investing, like moral hazard and the concept of "too big to fail"

Contains contributed chapters from numerous thought-leaders in the field of finance

Presents comprehensive coverage starting with the basics and bringing you through to cutting-edge, current theory and practice

Now more than ever, we need to be mindful of the social responsibilities of all investment practices. The recent financial crisis and recession has changed the financial landscape for years to come and Socially Responsible Finance and Investing is a timely guide to help us navigate this difficult terrain.

Un examen detallado del papel de la responsabilidad social en las finanzas e inversiones

Esto incluye la responsabilidad del lado corporativo (responsabilidad social corporativa) así como el lado inversionista (inversión socialmente responsable) de los mercados de capital. Repleto de ideas profundas y consejos prácticos, Socially Responsible Finance and Investing ofrece una base importante de conocimientos tanto sobre la teoría como sobre la práctica de esta esfera de financiación siempre cambiante.

Como parte de la serie Robert W. Kolb en Finanzas, este libro muestra capítulos de profesionales y académicos con amplia experiencia en este tema en particular. Proporciona una visión integral de las fundaciones socialmente responsables y sus aplicaciones para financiar e invertir según lo determinado por el estado actual de investigación.

Discusses many important issues associated with socially responsible finance and investment, like moral hazard and the concept of "too big to fail"

Contains contributed chapters from numerous thought-leaders in the field of finance

Presenta una cobertura integral comenzando por lo básico y trayéndote a la vanguardia, teoría actual y práctica

Ahora más que nunca, necesitamos tener en cuenta las responsabilidades sociales de todas las prácticas de inversión. La crisis financiera reciente y la recesión han cambiado el panorama financiero durante años por venir y Socialmente Responsable Finanzas e Invertir es una guía oportuna para ayudarnos a navegar por este difícil terreno.

title: Technical Analysis of Commodities
description:
Use technical analysis techniques to time your commodities trades and maximize your profit potential!

There are three primary forms of commodity market analysis: technical, fundamental, and seasonal. Successful trading most likely comes through of a combination of all three, but I believe technical analysis is the most critical because it enables traders to time entry and exit any speculative position. Simply being right about market direction doesn't guarantee profits; timing is everything!
translatedDescription:
¡Usa técnicas de análisis técnicos para ajustar sus comercios de productos básicos y maximizar su potencial de ganancia!

Existen tres formas primarias de análisis del mercado de productos básicos: técnicas, fundamentales y estacionales. El comercio exitoso probablemente viene a través de una combinación de los tres, pero creo que el análisis técnico es el más crítico porque permite a los traders entrar y salir de cualquier posición especulativa. Simplemente tener razón sobre la dirección del mercado no garantiza beneficios; el tiempo es todo!

title: Learning Red Hat Enterprise Linux & Fedora, Fourth Edition
description:
The GNU/Linux® success story is well known. Firmly established as a high-performance operating system, its worldwide installations are increasing at phenomenal rates. Much of this success has been on the server side, but more and more PC users are turning to Linux on the desktop, as well. For those grounded in Microsoft Windows® or Apple Macintosh® graphical interfaces, the first look at a powerful Unix-style operating system can be daunting. This book provides a clear, no-nonsense introduction to the popular Red Hat® distribution of Linux. It takes you through installation and shows you the key parts of the system, always with an eye toward what can go wrong and what you need to know to get over the humps. Linux is known as a secure environment and a good platform to run a web server. These topics are among the many covered in this book. But did you know you can also burn CDs, sync a PalmPilot™, and edit slideshow presentations with powerful tools on Linux? Those topics are covered here, too. Red Hat currently provides two distributions, both documented in this book. The first is their commercial, subscription-based product, called Red Hat Enterprise Linux and also available through retail channels as Red Hat Professional Workstation. The second is the freely distributed Fedora distribution. The Publisher's Edition of Fedora is included in this book on two disks. New in this edition are installation instructions for Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Fedora, package updating for Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Fedora, information on the GRUB bootloader, and the CUPS printer system. Learning Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Fedora tells you how to:

Prepare your system for installing Linux

Install and configure Linux and the two popular desktop environments, GNOME and KDE.

Run the most popular productivity tools on Linux: mailers, web browsers, OpenOffice, and Evolution.

Obtain and set up software through the Red Hat Package Manager (RPM)

Set up a Linux system for networking, either on your local area network (LAN), or via a dialup connection to the Internet.

Use the system-administration tools included with Red Hat, GNOME, and KDE, including such valuable utilities as Samba file-sharing and the Apache web server.

Understand and write shell scripts so you can peek under the hood and extend the power of Linux.

Para aquellos conectados en interfaces gráficas Microsoft Windows® o Apple Macintosh®, el primer vistazo a un poderoso sistema operativo de estilo Unix puede ser desalentador. Este libro proporciona una introducción clara y sin sentido a la popular distribución Red Hat® de Linux. El primero es su producto comercial basado en suscripción, llamado Red Hat Enterprise Linux y también disponible a través de canales minoristas como Red Hat Professional Workstation. title: What Happened to Goldman Sachs
description: This is the story of the slow evolution of Goldman Sachsaddressing why and how the firm changed from an ethical standard to a legal one as it grew to be a leading global corporation.In What Happened to Goldman Sachs, Steven G. Mandis uncovers the forces behind what he calls Goldman’s organizational drift.” Drawing from his firsthand experience; sociological research; analysis of SEC, congressional, and other filings; and a wide array of interviews with former clients, detractors, and current and former partners, Mandis uncovers the pressures that forced Goldman to slowly drift away from the very principles on which its reputation was built.Mandis evaluates what made Goldman Sachs so successful in the first place, how it responded to pressures to grow, why it moved away from the values and partnership culture that sustained it for so many years, what forces accelerated this drift, and why insiders can’tor won’trecognize this crucial change.Combining insightful analysis with engaging storytelling, Mandis has written an insider’s history that offers invaluable perspectives to business leaders interested in understanding and managing organizational drift in their own firms.
translatedDescription: Esta es la historia de la lenta evolución de Goldman Sachsaddressing por qué y cómo la firma cambió de un estándar ético a uno legal mientras crecía ser una corporación global líder. En lo que sucedió a Goldman Sachs, Steven G. Mandis descubre las fuerzas detrás de lo que él llama "la deriva organizativa de Goldman". Partiendo de su experiencia de primera mano; investigación sociológica; análisis de SEC, congresos y otros archivos; y una amplia gama de entrevistas con antiguos clientes, detractores y socios actuales y antiguos, Mandis descubre las presiones que obligaron a Goldman a alejarse lentamente de los mismos principios sobre los que se construyó su reputación. Mandis evalúa lo que hizo a Goldman Sachs tan exitoso en primer lugar, cómo respondió a las presiones para crecer, por qué se apartó de los valores y la cultura de la asociación que lo sostenía durante tantos años, qué fuerzas aceleró esta deriva, y por qué los internadores no pueden or no reconocer este cambio crucial. Combinando un análisis perspicaz con una narración atractiva, Mandis ha escrito la historia de un interno que ofrece perspectivas invaluables a los líderes empresariales interesados en comprender y gestionar la deriva organizativa en sus propias empresas.

title: The Definitive Guide to Business Finance: What smart managers do with the numbers, Second Edition
description:
‘Aspiring managers who have trouble with crunching numbers may have found a saviour in Richard Stutely.’

The Guardian

‘… a powerful tool for anyone involved with practical financial management issues. It is a superb balance between practical tips and hints and sufficient level of detail to enable you to challenge and make progress in improving the financial and operational performance of your organisation. It consciously avoids the sterile academic debates and focuses clearly on value added ideas and initiatives. The 10 questions sections are incredibly powerful.’

Simon Rogers,Senior Consultant in Big 4 Global Professional Services Firm

Don’t let a fear of finance hold you back. Play the numbers game … and win.

If you’re a manager or entrepreneur and you’re not proficient in the basics of business finance, you simply can't do your job well. If you need to get to grips with essentials like P&L accounts, budgets and forecasting, this is the only book you'll ever need. The Definitive Guide to Business Finance is focused on getting you up to speed - fast. Richard Stutely achieves what you might think is impossible, making business finance easy with an amusing, wry and common sense style that will make you wonder what you ever worried about. 

This book is a survival toolkit on the financial essentials. It assumes no specialised prior knowledge of finance and takes a guided step-by-step approach to all the techniques and concepts you need to understand, explaining the hows, whats and whys along the way. To make things even easier, it shows you how to use basic Excel spreadsheets to do all the calculations for you. Throughout the book, Richard Stutely shoes you how to crack the jargon and unveils shortcuts, tips and tricks that will make you look like a financial wizard.

If you're not yet a whiz with the numbers, you can definitely use this book to your advantage. If you're already a whiz, you will still find something new to improve your skills. Make the numbers add up for you.

“Los directores inspiradores que tienen problemas con los números crujientes pueden haber encontrado un salvador en Richard Stutely”.

translatedDescription: Forecasting Financial Markets proporciona una visión convincente de la psicología del comportamiento comercial - y muestra cómo una comprensión clara de tales patrones, y la capacidad de neutralizar las respuestas emocionales a las fluctuaciones del mercado, puede aumentar el éxito de la inversión.

title: Fragmenting Markets
description:
Post-crisis capital regulations and new failure-resolution rules increased the funding costs that are borne by bank shareholders, and thus the cost to buy-side firms for access to space on the balance sheets of large banks. A policy implication is the encouragement of market infrastructure and trading methods that reduce the amount of space on bank balance sheets that is needed to conduct a given amount of trade.

Using models and evidence, this book addresses the implications for financial-market liquidity of these regulations for systemically important banks and argues that current rules do not allow for potential levels of market efficiency and financial stability. In this insightful analysis of the impact of regulation on financial market efficiency post-2008, the author argues that bank capital levels could actually be pushed higher while still improving the liquidity of markets for safe assets such as low-risk fixed-income instruments by relaxing the leverage-ratio rule and increasing risk-based capital requirements.
translatedDescription:
Las regulaciones de capital después de la crisis y las nuevas reglas de la resolución de fallos aumentaron los costos de financiación que soportan los accionistas bancarios, y así el costo de las empresas de compra para el acceso al espacio en los balances de los grandes bancos. Una consecuencia de las políticas es el fomento de la infraestructura de mercado y los métodos comerciales que reducen la cantidad de espacio en los balances bancarios que se necesitan para realizar una cantidad determinada de comercio.

Utilizando modelos y pruebas, este libro aborda las implicaciones para la liquidez del mercado financiero de estas regulaciones para bancos sistémicamente importantes y sostiene que las normas actuales no permiten niveles potenciales de eficiencia del mercado y estabilidad financiera. En este análisis perspicaz del impacto de la regulación en la eficiencia del mercado financiero después de 2008, el autor argumenta que los niveles de capital bancario podrían ser realmente más altos, al tiempo que mejora la liquidez de los mercados para activos seguros como los instrumentos de renta fija de bajo riesgo, al relajar la regla de la relación ratio y aumentar las necesidades de capital basadas en el riesgo.

Iniciarse en el comercio de divisas, la cuarta edición es tanto una introducción como un manual de referencia para comerciantes principiantes e intermedios. Comenzando con una descripción del mercado de divisas (FOREX) y una breve historia, el libro incluye una sección invaluable compuesta por términos relevantes de FOREX claramente definidos utilizando ejemplos. El mercado FOREX ha crecido sustancialmente y evolucionado dramáticamente en los últimos años, y esta nueva edición está diseñada para ayudar al lector a adaptarse y aprovechar estos cambios.

Incluyendo la cobertura de cómo abrir una cuenta comercial, un paso a paso a través de los procesos físicos de colocación y liquidación de pedidos de divisas, e información sobre estrategia y tácticas comerciales completa con análisis fundamental y técnico, el libro tiene todo lo necesario para ayudar al comerciante en el proceso de toma de decisiones.

Nueva edición es revisada y ampliada para tener en cuenta todos los cambios recientes en el mercado monetario

Ahora incluye una introducción paso a paso para el nuevo comerciante y material adicional sobre la regulación

Los cálculos aritméticos FOREX se presentan de manera clara y fácil de entender

Recomendaciones, directrices y advertencias aparecen en todo el libro

Esta nueva edición de Iniciarse en el comercio de divisas contiene información nueva significativa, incluyendo un capítulo sobre ordenadores y FOREX, gestionado FOREX, y nueva información sobre regulación, junto con el exitoso plan comercial del autor, diseñado para ayudar al lector a juntarlo todo.

title: The Monetary System
description:
A groundbreaking work that paves the way for a new, pro-active financial system

With The Monetary System, innovative author pairing Jean-Francois Serval and Jean-Pascal Tranie devise a comprehensive economic modeling system that accounts for the unprecedented situation facing international and regional economies by developing a controversial new stance on the operation of money in society. Presenting a classification of financial instruments with a view toward their underlying legal structures, the book sheds new light on the present economic and financial problems of slow growth and rising debts, and proposes possible outcomes for the global economy.

The authors have already gained international attention with their novel approach to currency, and now they turn their attention to the social function of money in all its myriad forms. The book provides a way forward in an era of increased life expectancy and other new social patterns and the social role of money provides a framework for understanding intergenerational redistribution—an urgently pressing task in our time.

New aggregate financial categories and economic modeling reveal a possible foundation for increased financial stability
Companion website includes key mathematical models, accounting standards, and PowerPoint slides
Comprehensive theoretical underpinning presents the contemporary model of money as a social contract
Insights into the current economic situation make sense of sovereign debt risk in markets around the world

With questions and answers at the end of each chapter, The Monetary System will help you form a new conception of the role of money in society. Improved regulation and tax policies are needed to stabilize the global economy, and this book provides the framework for getting there.
translatedDescription:
Un trabajo innovador que allana el camino para un nuevo sistema financiero proactivo

Con el Sistema Monetario, el autor innovador par Jean-Francois Serval y Jean-Pascal Tranie diseñan un sistema de modelado económico global que explica la situación sin precedentes que enfrentan las economías internacionales y regionales desarrollando una nueva postura polémica sobre el funcionamiento del dinero en la sociedad. Presentando una clasificación de instrumentos financieros con miras a sus estructuras jurídicas subyacentes, el libro arroja nueva luz sobre los actuales problemas económicos y financieros del lento crecimiento y el aumento de las deudas, y propone posibles resultados para la economía mundial.

Los autores ya han ganado la atención internacional con su enfoque novedoso de la moneda, y ahora se centran en la función social del dinero en todas sus múltiples formas. El libro proporciona un camino adelante en una era de mayor esperanza de vida y otros nuevos patrones sociales y el papel social del dinero proporciona un marco para comprender la redistribución intergeneracional, una tarea urgente en nuestro tiempo.

Nuevas categorías financieras agregadas y modelos económicos revelan una posible base para aumentar la estabilidad financiera
El sitio web de Companion incluye modelos matemáticos clave, estándares de contabilidad y diapositivas de PowerPoint
Fundamento teórico integral presenta el modelo contemporáneo del dinero como contrato social
Insights into the current economic situation make sense of sovereign debt risk in markets around the world

Con preguntas y respuestas al final de cada capítulo, el Sistema Monetario le ayudará a formar una nueva concepción del papel del dinero en la sociedad. Es necesario mejorar la regulación y las políticas fiscales para estabilizar la economía mundial, y este libro proporciona el marco para llegar allí.

title: Strategic Fixed Income Investing: An Insider's Perspective on Bond Markets, Analysis, and Portfolio Management
description:
Build a fixed income portfolio that will weather volatility and instability

Designing a fixed income portfolio is an essential skill of any investment manager or advisor. This book outlines the critical components to successfully navigate through stable and turbulent markets, using real-life lessons from a seasoned institutional asset manager. The first section includes commentary on the changing fixed income market and overall economy, while the second section outlines the processes to navigate these ever-evolving markets including portfolio construction, the Federal Reserve, credit analysis and trade execution. Ladder Methodology is highlighted and the book discusses its pros and cons, gives examples of both well-constructed and poorly executed laddered bond portfolios and offers alternatives to traditional asset classes.

Benefit from lessons learned, providing real life examples of market scenarios and trades

Prepare fixed income portfolios that can weather any storm

Written by Sean P. Simko, an expert on fixed income investing, who shares his investing experiences from the past 16 years

Outlines the key principles of the Ladder strategy

From strategy to execution, Strategic Fixed Income Investing offers the road map to help investment managers prepare portfolios that will insulate investments against adverse market conditions.
translatedDescription:
Construir una cartera de ingresos fijos que hará que el tiempo sea volatilidad e inestabilidad

El diseño de una cartera de ingresos fijos es una habilidad esencial de cualquier administrador o asesor de inversiones. Este libro describe los componentes críticos para navegar con éxito a través de mercados estables y turbulentos, utilizando lecciones de vida real de un administrador de activos institucionales experimentado. La primera sección incluye comentarios sobre el cambiante mercado de ingresos fijos y la economía general, mientras que la segunda sección describe los procesos para navegar por estos mercados siempre cambiantes, incluyendo la construcción de carteras, la Reserva Federal, el análisis de crédito y la ejecución comercial. Se destaca la Metodología de la Escalera y el libro analiza sus pros y contras, da ejemplos de carteras de bonos bien construidas y mal ejecutadas y ofrece alternativas a las clases de activos tradicionales.

Beneficio de las lecciones aprendidas, proporcionando ejemplos reales de escenarios y comercios de mercado

Preparar carteras de ingresos fijos que pueden meteorizar cualquier tormenta

Escrito por Sean P. Simko, un experto en inversiones de renta fija, que comparte sus experiencias de inversión de los últimos 16 años

Subraya los principios fundamentales de la estrategia de la escalera

De estrategia a ejecución, Strategic Fixed Income Investing ofrece la hoja de ruta para ayudar a los administradores de inversiones a preparar carteras que aíslan inversiones contra condiciones adversas del mercado.

title: High-Profit IPO Strategies: Finding Breakout IPOs for Investors and Traders, 3rd Edition
description:
A detailed guide to the new era of IPO investing

Typically generating a great deal of interest, excitement, and volatility, initial public offerings (IPOs) offer investors and traders with opportunities for both short-term and long-term profits. In the Third Edition of High-Profit IPO Strategies, IPO expert Tom Taulli explains all facets of IPO investing and trading, with a particular emphasis on the industries that are fueling the next generation of IPOs, from social networking and cloud computing to mobile technology.

In the past year alone, many of these types of IPOs have provided enormous opportunities for nimble traders as prices have fluctuated widely for several months following the offering. This new edition reflects the new IPO environment and presents you with the insights needed to excel in such a dynamic arena.

Discusses more sophisticated IPO trading strategies, explores the intricacies of the IPO process, and examines the importance of focused financial statement analysis

Contains new chapters on secondary IPO markets, reverse mergers, and master limited partnerships

Provides in-depth analysis of other major industries generating worthwhile IPOs

Covers IPO investing from basic terms to advanced investing techniques

Comprehensive in scope, the Third Edition of High-Profit IPO Strategies offers investors and traders with actionable information to profit in this lucrative sector of the financial market.
translatedDescription:
Una guía detallada de la nueva era de inversión de IPO

Típicamente generando una gran cantidad de interés, emoción y volatilidad, las ofertas públicas iniciales (OPI) ofrecen a los inversores y comerciantes oportunidades tanto a corto plazo como a largo plazo. En la tercera edición de Estrategias de IPO de alto rendimiento, el experto de IPO Tom Taulli explica todas las facetas de la inversión y el comercio de IPO, con un énfasis particular en las industrias que alimentan a la próxima generación de IPOs, desde redes sociales y computación en la nube a la tecnología móvil.

Sólo en el último año, muchos de estos tipos de OPI han proporcionado enormes oportunidades para los comerciantes ágiles ya que los precios han fluctuado ampliamente durante varios meses después de la oferta. Esta nueva edición refleja el nuevo entorno de la IPO y le presenta las ideas necesarias para sobresalir en un escenario tan dinámico.

Examina estrategias comerciales más sofisticadas de la OPI, explora las complejidades del proceso de la OPI y examina la importancia del análisis de estados financieros centrados

Contiene nuevos capítulos sobre mercados secundarios de la OPI, fusiones inversas y asociaciones limitadas master

Proporciona un análisis a fondo de otras industrias importantes que generan OPI valiosos

Cubre IPO invirtiendo desde términos básicos a técnicas avanzadas de inversión

Amplio alcance, la Tercera Edición de Estrategias IPO de alto rendimiento ofrece a los inversores y comerciantes información práctica para beneficiarse en este sector lucrativo del mercado financiero.

title: Day Trading Commodity Futures
description:
What you need to know in order to successfully day trade commodities.

Day trading has drawn droves of new speculators into highly leveraged commodity markets. This essay prepares traders for the realities of day trading, and steers them clear of common pitfalls. Day trading is one of the most difficult strategies to employ successfully. Yet, with difficulty comes potential reward for those who can manage emotions and pay their “experience” dues...
translatedDescription:
Lo que usted necesita saber para tener éxito en el comercio de mercancías.

El comercio diurno ha llevado a nuevos especuladores a mercados de productos básicos altamente aprovechados. Este ensayo prepara a los comerciantes para las realidades del comercio diurno, y los aleja de los obstáculos comunes. El comercio diurno es una de las estrategias más difíciles de emplear con éxito. Sin embargo, con dificultad viene recompensa potencial para aquellos que pueden manejar las emociones y pagar sus cuotas de “experiencia”...

title: The Flexible Investing Playbook: Asset Allocation Strategies for Long-Term Success
description:
How to make sensible investment decisions during these turbulent times

2008 changed everything. Now, more than ever, investors need to be proactive in planning for their retirement. To do so, they must look beyond simply investing in stocks and bonds, while avoiding what may be overwhelming and even misleading investment advice. In The Flexible Investing Playbook: Asset Allocation for Long-Term Success, Robert Isbitts—mutual fund manager, investment strategist, newsletter writer, and author of Wall Street's Bull and How to Bear It—shares the strategies he created and uses with his clients. This approach can potentially allow their portfolios to withstand the volatility of the stock market and subdue the emotional impact of investing, to increase the chances of reaching their investment goals. Along the way, the book:

Reviews the events of the 2008 financial market debacle, and identifies key lessons investors should learn from that experience

Discusses how traditional approaches to diversification are fraught with risks, and how they may endanger the pursuit of a secure retirement

Details why he believes investors cannot live on stocks and bonds alone, while also describing how to properly diversify, without sacrificing precious liquidity

The Flexible Investing Playbook, he presents a proactive approach to investing that's based on the strategies Isbitts created, designed and currently manages.
translatedDescription:
Cómo tomar decisiones de inversión razonables durante estos tiempos turbulentos

2008 cambió todo. Ahora, más que nunca, los inversores necesitan ser proactivos en la planificación para su jubilación. Para ello, deben ir más allá de invertir simplemente en acciones y bonos, evitando al mismo tiempo lo que puede ser abrumador e incluso engañoso consejo de inversión. En The Flexible Investing Playbook: Asset Allocation for Long-Term Success, Robert Isbitts, gerente de fondos múltiples, estratega de inversiones, escritor de boletines y autor de Wall Street's Bull y How to Bear It, comparte las estrategias que creó y utiliza con sus clientes. This approach can potentially allow their portfolios to resist the volatility of the stock market and subdue the emotional impact of investment, to increase the chances of reaching their investment goals. En el camino, el libro:

Reseña los acontecimientos de la debacle del mercado financiero de 2008, e identifica las lecciones clave que los inversores deben aprender de esa experiencia

Discusses how traditional approaches to diversification are fraught with risks, and how they may endanger the pursuit of a secure removal

Details why he believes investors cannot live on stocks and bonds alone, while also describing how to properly diversify, without sacrificing precious liquidity

El Flexible Investing Playbook, presenta un enfoque proactivo para invertir que se basa en las estrategias Isbitts creadas, diseñadas y gestionadas actualmente.

title: Dark Trading
description: This book explores the pressing topic of dark trading. Following new EU legislation regulating financial markets (MiFID II and MiFIR), it traces the development of off-market securities trading (“dark trading”), analyzes economic studies of this development, and positions the resulting regulatory framework of the EU over against that of the US. The study closes with proposals for reform that provide new impetus for further academic discussion.
translatedDescription: Este libro explora el tema apremiante del comercio oscuro. A raíz de la nueva legislación de la UE que regula los mercados financieros (MiFID II y MiFIR), traza el desarrollo del comercio de valores fuera del mercado (“comercio oscuro”), analiza los estudios económicos de este desarrollo y posiciona el marco regulatorio resultante de la UE contra el de Estados Unidos. El estudio cierra las propuestas de reforma que dan nuevo impulso a un nuevo debate académico.

title: F# for Quantitative Finance
description:
"F# for Quantitative Finance" provides an accessible introduction to using the F# programming language for tackling real-world problems in quantitative finance. You will learn how to leverage F# through practical code examples to build systems such as an automated trading system while exploring key financial concepts.

What this Book will help me do

Develop financial models and applications using the functional features of F#.
Quickly process and analyze financial data effectively within the .NET platform.
Design and implement an end-to-end automated trading system with F#.
Understand key financial concepts like volatility and quantitative hedging strategies.
Gain proficiency in F# programming and Visual Studio as tools for quantitative computing.

Author(s)

Johan Astborg is a seasoned software developer and quantitative analyst with extensive experience in leveraging modern programming paradigms for financial applications. With a deep passion for functional programming and finance, Johan has written this book to empower analysts and developers to harness F# for sophisticated quantitative tasks. His clear and engaging writing style stems from years of teaching practical programming skills.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for quantitative analysts, financial engineers, and researchers who wish to develop a strong understanding of functional programming, particularly using F# within financial domain problems. Beginners to F# or functional programming will appreciate the structured introduction. It is also valuable for finance professionals looking for modern computational tools for quantitative problem-solving in their field. A basic comprehension of financial concepts is sufficient to follow along.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Desarrollar modelos financieros y aplicaciones usando las características funcionales de F#.
Procesar y analizar rápidamente los datos financieros efectivamente dentro de la plataforma .NET.
